title: Pure Ritual Art
summary: The 'Ritual Art' strategy revolves around the twin Normal Monster Ritual Spells: Advanced Ritual Art (which Ritual Summons any Ritual Monster from your HAND by sending a Normal Monster from your DECK to the GY) and High Ritual Art (which Ritual Summons any Ritual Monster directly from your DECK by Tributing a Normal Monster from your HAND)! By pairing both Ritual Art Spells with Level 8 Normal Monster Blue-Eyes White Dragon, Blue-Eyes Chaos MAX Dragon (4000 ATK, untargetable, indestructible, double piercing damage), and Blue-Eyes Chaos Dragon, a single Melody of Awakening Dragon searches both Blue-Eyes White Dragon and Chaos MAX Dragon—allowing you to summon BOTH Chaos Dragons in one turn!

allow.Blue-Eyes Chaos MAX Dragon: Level 8 DARK Dragon Ritual boss (4000 ATK): summoned from hand by Advanced Ritual Art or from Deck by High Ritual Art; cannot be targeted or destroyed by card effects and inflicts DOUBLE piercing battle damage!
allow.Blue-Eyes Chaos Dragon: Level 8 DARK Dragon Ritual boss (3000 ATK): cannot be targeted or destroyed by opponent's card effects; when Ritual Summoned using Blue-Eyes White Dragon, flips all opponent's monsters into 0 ATK/DEF Defense Position on attack declaration!
allow.Blue-Eyes White Dragon: Level 8 LIGHT Dragon Normal Monster (3000 ATK): sent from Deck to GY by Advanced Ritual Art, OR Tributed from hand by High Ritual Art to fulfill the Level 8 requirement AND unlock Blue-Eyes Chaos Dragon's board-flip effect!
allow.The Melody of Awakening Dragon: Normal Spell that discards 1 card to search BOTH Blue-Eyes White Dragon and Blue-Eyes Chaos MAX Dragon / Blue-Eyes Chaos Dragon at the same time!
allow.Summoner's Art: Normal Spell that adds Level 8 Normal Monster Blue-Eyes White Dragon directly from your Deck to your hand so High Ritual Art is immediately live!
allow.Chaos Form: Ritual Spell that banishes Blue-Eyes White Dragon from your GY to Ritual Summon a second Chaos MAX or Chaos Dragon from your hand!
allow.Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands: Level 4 Fairy that searches Advanced Ritual Art, High Ritual Art, Blue-Eyes Chaos MAX Dragon, or Blue-Eyes Chaos Dragon on Normal Summon.
allow.Impcantation Talismandra: Reveals Chaos MAX or Chaos Dragon in hand to Special Summon itself and Candoll from the Deck, searching a Ritual Spell.
allow.Impcantation Candoll: Reveals Advanced Ritual Art or High Ritual Art in hand to Special Summon itself and Talismandra from the Deck, searching a Ritual Monster.
allow.Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic: Rank 8 Dragon Xyz summoned using two Level 8 Ritual/Blue-Eyes Dragons during Main Phase 2 to bypass High Ritual Art's shuffle-back!
allow.Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres: Link-2 Dragon made with two Dragons.

main: Advanced Ritual Art

Core Ritual Spell: Ritual Summons any 1 Ritual Monster from your HAND (Blue-Eyes Chaos MAX Dragon or Blue-Eyes Chaos Dragon!) by sending Normal Monsters (Blue-Eyes White Dragon!) from your DECK to the GY!
High Ritual Art

Core Ritual Spell: Ritual Summons any 1 Ritual Monster directly from your DECK (Blue-Eyes Chaos MAX Dragon or Blue-Eyes Chaos Dragon!) by Tributing Normal Monsters (Blue-Eyes White Dragon!) from your HAND!
Contract with the Abyss
Classic DARK Ritual Spell that tributes monsters from your hand or field to Ritual Summon DARK Ritual Monsters Blue-Eyes Chaos MAX Dragon or Blue-Eyes Chaos Dragon.
Blue-Eyes Chaos MAX Dragon
Signature Level 8 DARK Dragon Ritual finisher (4000 ATK / 0 DEF): cannot be targeted or destroyed by your opponent's card effects, and inflicts DOUBLE piercing battle damage!
Blue-Eyes Chaos Dragon

Signature Level 8 DARK Dragon Ritual enabler (3000 ATK / 0 DEF): cannot be targeted or destroyed by opponent's card effects; when attacking, changes all opponent's monsters to 0 ATK/DEF Defense Position!
Blue-Eyes White Dragon
Level 8 Normal Monster fuel: sent from Deck to GY by Advanced Ritual Art, Tributed from hand by High Ritual Art, and banished from GY by Chaos Form!
The Melody of Awakening Dragon
Discards 1 card to search BOTH Blue-Eyes White Dragon AND Blue-Eyes Chaos MAX Dragon or Blue-Eyes Chaos Dragon simultaneously!
Summoner's Art
Adds Blue-Eyes White Dragon from your Deck to your hand with zero cost to turn on High Ritual Art and Melody of Awakening Dragon.
Chaos Form
Banishes Blue-Eyes White Dragon from your GY to Ritual Summon a second Chaos MAX or Chaos Dragon from your hand.
Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands
Normal Summon starter that searches Advanced Ritual Art, High Ritual Art, Chaos MAX Dragon, or Chaos Dragon.
Impcantation Talismandra
Reveals a Ritual Monster in hand to summon itself and Candoll from the Deck, searching Advanced Ritual Art or High Ritual Art.
Impcantation Candoll
Reveals Advanced Ritual Art or High Ritual Art in hand to summon itself and Talismandra from the Deck, searching Chaos MAX or Chaos Dragon.
extra: Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy
Rank 8 Dragon Xyz (2 Level 8 monsters): overlays a Ritual Monster summoned by High Ritual Art in Main Phase 2 so it is not shuffled back into the Deck, while providing Spell negation!
Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres
Link-2 Dragon made with two Dragons to bounce a card on the opponent's turn.
